description: Same as straight_2m_then_left_door, but with no 0.8 m pre-point: approach_dist_m 0.05, so EnterDoor's goal is the door itself (centre, yaw = the way through) and mpc_corr's goal_pose_use_yaw corridor curves the car onto the door axis on its own. WHY: from the end of the 2 m straight the 0.8 m pre-point is not drivable at the door's yaw (83 deg of turn inside 1.0 m of lateral room needs R 0.71 m against R_min 0.92 m), so on the original mission mpc_corr falls back to the bearing corridor and nothing changes; the door centre is (kappa 0.5-0.7 against a limit of 1.08 on 2026-11-05T14-35-46's geometry). The 2 m straight is also what lets the door detector confirm the door (confirmation wants pose spread along the approach). The door is picked ONCE, when the second move starts: the nearest STRONG confirmed door on the left of the car's heading at that moment (side_of: positive relative bearing). It is held for the rest of the move, never re-picked. A door on the left that is already behind the car still counts as left, and the car turns back to it. Needs a door detector publishing /perception/doors_semantic and the global EKF. If no left door is found within 5 s of the second move starting, the move fails door_not_found and the mission aborts. The pre-point is 0.05 m back on the door axis, i.e. the door itself. Entered means within 0.15 m along the axis, within 0.05 m sideways of it, and within 10 deg of it.
